title: Analysis: the Trump family has generated about $1.4B from crypto projects since Trump's inauguration a year ago, making up about one-fifth of their fortune (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Analysis: the Trump family has generated about $1.4B from crypto projects since Trump's inauguration a year ago, making up about one-fifth of their fortune — Digital assets added $1.4 billion to the first family's wealth over the past year, making up about one-fifth of their fortune for the first time
